answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 57352 Country: India Title: iam a maktab member in masjid.iam having doubts regarding financial matters. Question: I am a maktab member in masjid. In our maktab they are conducting classes for school students in morning and evening. It is not a full time maktab, but they collected qurbani skins for the development. Is it halal though they are not providing any food and accommodation to students? Answer ID: 57352 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 290/290/M=03/1436) The price of the skin of qurbani is just like zakah i.e. it becomes wajib to give its price in sadaqah as well as to give into complete possession of the poor. Hence it is not lawful to use the price of skin to meet the needs of the maktab or pay the salary of teachers. فإن بيع اللحم أو الجلد به أى بمستهلك أو بدراهم تصدق بثمنه – (درمختار، كتاب الأضحية ص 475/9 ط زكريا) لا يصرف إلى بناء نحو مسجد كبناء الفناطر والسقايا واصلاح الطرقات وكرى الأنهار والحج والجهاد وكل مالا تمليك . (درمختار مع الشامى ص 291/3 كتاب الزكاة ط زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
